observation.visible_scene: A hydraulic press setup against a plain light-gray background. A cylindrical top platen wrapped in diagonal yellow-and-black hazard stripes descends toward a matching striped cylindrical base platen. Standing on the base platen between the platens is a black hammer head with a wooden handle (red-painted end) protruding horizontally to the left; a shiny curved metal lip (the hammer's claw/edge) sits under the top platen.
visible_changes: The striped top platen moves steadily downward throughout the clip; as it lowers, the bare silver cylinder above the stripes becomes increasingly visible at the top of the frame.
The shiny curved metal piece between the platens is progressively compressed and flattened: its thin upward-curving lip thickens and creases as the gap between the platens closes.
The black hammer head/neck bends and tilts slightly under the load, with its upper right hook curving more as the press descends.
The wooden handle and the bottom striped platen remain fixed in position; the background shows no change, indicating a static camera.
outside_clip_unknowns: The exact identity of the metal piece (whether it is the hammer's claw or a separate object) and the material of the black head.
The press force, the state before the segment began, and any final collapse or outcome after the segment ends.
Whether the handle is held by an operator or clamped.
uncertain_details: The deformation of the metal lip versus the black head is gradual and small per frame; the precise amount of bending of the black neck is hard to quantify.
Whether the apparent reveal of the silver top is purely from the platen descending or partly from framing.
